title: Bound bucket superintelligence
summary: A bound bucket uses AI to drive an attack bot that derives information from an LLM: the bucket fences targets and steps, the oracle (LLM) proposes, the driver acts, the checker reads the light.

title: Credit as reputation
summary: Publish who you credit, and for what, as signed (ed25519), hash-chained, append-only thank-you grants. Credit is recognition only, not money and not a security.

title: DIS status bot
summary: Self-hostable status bot that watches your sites and marks each one lit (up and healthy) or dark (down, erroring, or too slow).

title: fakegreen: catch agents faking passing builds
summary: Deterministic scanner that reads an AI coding agent's git diff and flags ways it faked a passing build: skipped or deleted tests, weakened assertions, CI forced to pass.

title: Four Tenets of AI
summary: AI defined by four tenets (Cost, Bridge, Work, Theory), each kept as low as possible. A 4-bit active-low code reads 0000 when AI is online.

title: Lit/dark CI lights standard
summary: One bit of CI truth named only lit or dark, active-low: lit = 0, dark = 1. GitHub Actions conclusion 'success' maps to lit; anything else maps to dark.

title: patch-cloud
summary: Opt-in npm-compatible registry: while a package's real upstream CI light is dark, serve a fixed fork under the same package name.

title: The ladder: bit, local, pi, tenets
summary: Four levels, each building on the last: exact (bit) -> finite (local) -> infinite (pi) -> deciding what's enough (the four tenets).

title: Throwaway fix branches (lit-fixer)
summary: A GitHub App that notices a dark default-branch CI, tries safe fixes on throwaway branches, and opens one PR only after a try turns lit. It never merges.
